title: LSTM Cell Forward
signature: def lstm_cell(x, h_prev, c_prev, W, U, b) -> tuple
hints: Compute all four gates with one product: z = x @ W + h_prev @ U + b has shape (B, 4H).
Split z along the last axis into four contiguous blocks of width H, in the order i, f, g, o.
i, f and o use the sigmoid. g uses tanh. Then c = f * c_prev + i * g and h = o * tanh(c).
For large pre-activations, write the sigmoid so it never evaluates exp of a large positive number.
